description: Source code for the PurchaseOrder class and related functions in the ERPNext system, handling purchase order operations including validation, status updates, and document mapping.

classes.name: PurchaseOrder
classes.description: Represents a purchase order in ERPNext, handling validation, status updates, and document mapping.

methods.name: item_last_purchase_rate
methods.description: Fetches the last purchase rate for a specific item, considering conversion rates and factors.

methods.name: close_or_unclose_purchase_orders
methods.description: Closes or reopens purchase orders based on permissions and current status.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets missing values in a target document based on a source document.

methods.name: make_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Creates a purchase receipt from a purchase order.

methods.name: make_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Creates a purchase invoice from a purchase order.

methods.name: make_purchase_invoice_from_portal
methods.description: Creates a purchase invoice from a purchase order via portal, with permission check.

methods.name: get_mapped_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Maps a purchase order to a purchase invoice, including post-processing steps.

methods.name: make_rm_stock_entry
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for raw materials transfer related to a purchase order.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches item details such as description and allow_alternative_item for given item codes.

methods.name: get_list_context
methods.description: Provides context data for listing purchase orders on the website.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the status of a purchase order and related documents.

methods.name: get_materials_from_supplier
methods.description: Retrieves available materials from a supplier for a purchase order.

methods.name: make_return_stock_entry_for_subcontract
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for returning materials in a subcontracting process.

methods.name: add_items_in_ste
methods.description: Adds items to a stock entry document for subcontracting.
